headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 1,091.5 Million Dollars From 1,350.8 Million As Deribit Drops To 18.0 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges fell to 1,091.5 million dollars from 1,350.8 million, equal to 0.4023 percent of the 271.3 billion dollars held on those venues, compared with 0.4969 percent on the prior reading. Deribit intake dropped to 18.0 million dollars from 178.5 million and Bitfinex intake dropped to 132.8 million dollars from 229.6 million; a positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance intake rose to 881.8 million dollars from 852.3 million, while OKX sent out 38.5 million dollars and Bitget took in 73.0 million dollars.
author: jordan
